sentences.zh: 而现在，她受到的攻击却来自于她经常形容为自己最喜欢的总统。

sentences.en: Her favorite president was unleashing, in her view, these threats.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，她最喜欢的总统正在放任这些威胁。

sentences.en: And it's not just that the threats were levied against her.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是针对她本人的威胁。

sentences.en: They were levied against her own children, and her children were named.
sentences.zh: 这些威胁还指向了她的亲生孩子，甚至点出了她孩子的名字。

sentences.en: I know this because Greene told me that and said she was terrified.
sentences.zh: 我之所以知道这一点，是因为格林亲口告诉了我，并说她当时吓坏了。

sentences.en: So it was really, really alarming and scary for her.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的让她感到非常惊恐和害怕。

sentences.en: And so this was—I was getting all these texts, by the way, you know, from friends of mine in the political world saying, she's rebranding herself.
sentences.zh: 所以当时——顺便说一句，我不断收到政界朋友发来的短信，说她在重塑公众形象。

sentences.en: What is this about?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And what is your sense about what these appearances were really about?
sentences.zh: 你觉得她这些公开露面到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: Were they driven by the feedback she was getting from her constituents?
sentences.zh: 是因为受到了选民反馈的驱使吗？

sentences.en: Was it something else?
sentences.zh: 还是有别的原因？

sentences.en: Yes, the former.
sentences.zh: 是的，是前者。

sentences.en: Tinged also with the belief of, what the hell, I've got nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 其中也夹杂着一种“管他呢，反正我没什么可失去的”的心态。

sentences.en: Since when has my unflagging loyalty paid off for me?
sentences.zh: 我那坚定不移的忠诚什么时候真正回报过我？

sentences.en: It hasn't.
sentences.zh: 从来没有。

sentences.en: So she felt somewhat liberated from her allegiances to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，她觉得自己从对特朗普总统的效忠中某种程度上获得了解脱。

sentences.en: But I think alongside that, she truly believed what she was saying.
sentences.zh: 但我认为与此同时，她是真心相信自己所说的话。

sentences.en: She truly had heard what her constituents had been telling her, that they were, like her, taking the president's principle of America first, not just seriously, but literally.
sentences.zh: 她确实听到了选民对她所说的话，他们和她一样，不仅严肃对待、而且字面意义上地践行着总统“美国优先”的原则。

sentences.en: You know, they were saying, hang on, how is it America first to be not just supporting Ukraine, but also Israel?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在说，等等，既不支持乌克兰、同时又支持以色列，这怎么能叫“美国优先”呢？

sentences.en: Do we not care about women who have been victimized by the rich and powerful?
sentences.zh: 难道我们不关心那些饱受权贵侵害的女性吗？

sentences.en: And meanwhile, things are still expensive.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，物价依然居高不下。

sentences.en: Why isn't the president out there every day doing something about this?
sentences.zh: 为什么总统不每天都出来为之做点什么？

sentences.en: These were the tenets of America first that they believed the president would be addressing, that Marjorie Taylor Greene was certain he would be addressing.
sentences.zh: 这些正是他们认为总统会去解决的“美国优先”信条，也是玛乔丽·泰勒·格林确信总统会去解决的问题。

sentences.en: But she now began to have doubts, in part because she was hearing her constituents raise those very same doubts.
sentences.zh: 但她现在开始产生怀疑，部分原因是因为她听到选民们也提出了同样的怀疑。

sentences.en: And not long after.
sentences.zh: 不久之后。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: She announces that she's going to resign.
sentences.zh: 她宣布自己将要辞职。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I've always represented the common American man and woman as a member of the House of Representatives, which is why I've always been despised in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 作为一名众议院议员，我一直代表着普通的美国男女民众，这也是为什么我总是在华盛顿特区招人嫌弃

sentences.en: and just never fit in.
sentences.zh: 且永远无法融入其中。

sentences.en: She did a video that she posted on X.
sentences.zh: 她录制了一段视频并发布在X平台上。

sentences.en: I ran for Congress in 2020 and have fought every single day, believing that make America great again meant America firSt.
sentences.zh: 我在2020年竞选国会议员，并且每一天都在奋斗，坚信“让美国再次伟大”就意味着“美国优先”。

sentences.en: It was a posting that took even her close allies by surprise.
sentences.zh: 这条动态甚至让她的亲密盟友都感到大吃一惊。

sentences.en: America first should mean America first and only Americans firSt.
sentences.zh: “美国优先”应当意味着美国优先，并且只有美国人优先。

sentences.en: It became, I think, obvious to most, if not all, that it was really her renouncing a movement that had strayed from its core America first principle.
sentences.zh: 我想，对大多数人（如果不是全部人）来说，这已经变得很明显了，她实际上是在与一个偏离了“美国优先”核心原则的运动决裂。

sentences.en: I do not want my sweet district to have to endure a hurtful and hateful primary against me by the president that we all fought for.
sentences.zh: 我不希望我可爱的选区经受由我们所有人曾为其奋战的总统所发起的、充满恶意和仇恨的初选挑战。

sentences.en: And that she would be fighting if she were to be reelected on behalf of a president who now disliked her and who had done her great injury.
sentences.zh: 如果她为了一个现在已经厌恶她并对她造成巨大伤害的总统而选择连任，她将不得不为此而战。

sentences.en: But also who no longer was the embodiment of America firSt.
sentences.zh: 而且这个总统也不再是“美国优先”的化身。

sentences.en: And so what was the point of that?
sentences.zh: 那这样做还有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: I have to ask, Robert, isn't the fact that Green stepped down over this dust-up a sign that Trump is actually stronger politically than we may be thinking?
sentences.zh: 罗伯特，我不得不问，格林因为这场风波而辞职，难道不正是特朗普在政治上实际上比我们想象的要更强大的信号吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think a lot of people might see this incident as him winning.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很多人可能会把这一事件视为他的胜利。

sentences.en: He still, at the end of the day, had the political weight to drive one of his critics out of political office.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他最终依然拥有将自己的批评者逐出政坛的政治分量。

sentences.en: Historically, that has been the case, just as you described it, Natalie, that this is a show of Trump's power.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，情况确实如此，正如你所描述的，娜塔莉，这确实展现了特朗普的力量。

sentences.en: But to say that now would be to ignore the atmospherics, that all of this is taking place at a point in which Trump's approval rating is near the lowest that it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 但如果现在这么说，就是忽视了当前的舆论氛围——所有这一切都发生在特朗普的支持率接近其历史最低点的时期。

sentences.en: At a time when people on the right, like Tucker Carlson, are beginning to, you know, speak with a great deal of bluntness,
sentences.zh: 在这个时候，右翼人士（比如塔克·卡尔森）开始，你知道的，直言不讳地表达观点，

sentences.en: with real candor about the Trump administration's misguided priorities.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普政府误入歧途的优先事项进行真正的坦诚批评。

sentences.en: So if this was just crushing the one lone dissenter and everybody then issuing a chorus on the right of good riddance to her, we all love President Trump, it'd be one thing,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这仅仅是击垮了一个孤立的异见者，然后右翼的所有人都随声附和、欢送她离开、表达我们都热爱特朗普总统，那倒还另当别论，

sentences.en: but that's not actually what's taken place.
sentences.zh: 但现实并非如此。

sentences.en: She simply said Trump's White House is not doing what they said they were going to do.
sentences.zh: 她只是说特朗普的白宫没有兑现他们承诺要做的事。

sentences.en: And that sentiment is one that is beginning to gain a lot of traction on the right.
sentences.zh: 而这种情绪正在右翼群体中获得越来越多的认同。

sentences.en: It's extending to the Trump coalition that got him reelected in 2024.
sentences.zh: 它正在延伸至2024年让他重新当选的特朗普联盟内部。

sentences.en: I don't think that his hardcore base has deserted him.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他的铁杆支持基盘抛弃了他。

sentences.en: But the bottom has really fallen out of his support amongst independents.
sentences.zh: 但他在独立选民中的支持率确实已经彻底崩盘了。

sentences.en: And they were key to his victory, as were young people and black males and Latino males as well.
sentences.zh: 而他们正是他获胜的关键，年轻人、黑人男性以及拉丁裔男性也是如此。

sentences.en: Now, whether it's because of their own experiences or because they happen to be listening to Tucker Carlson, to Nick Fuentes and to other influencers or a combination,
sentences.zh: 无论是出于他们自身的亲身经历，还是因为他们恰好在收听塔克·卡尔森、尼克·富恩特斯和其他意见领袖的节目，亦或是两者的结合，

sentences.en: the polling data clearly shows that these people who were so crucial to Trump's victory in 2024 are starting to move away from him in really, really significant numbers.
sentences.zh: 民调数据清楚地表明，这些对特朗普2024年胜利至关重要的人，正以非常非常显著的规模开始疏远他。

sentences.en: And so even if his core base remains steadfast,
sentences.zh: 因此，即便他的核心基本盘依然坚定不移，

sentences.en: the clear and present danger for the Trump administration is that he no longer has a solid coalition of the type that brought him victory.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府面临的现实而紧迫的危机在于，他不再拥有那种曾带给他胜利的稳固政治联盟。

sentences.en: I just want to say hello, Pennsylvania, and I'm thrilled to be back.
sentences.zh: 我只想说声宾夕法尼亚你们好，我很高兴能重返这里。

sentences.en: — Robert, I want to end by asking if you get the sense that Trump is actually listening, perhaps,
sentences.zh: ——罗伯特，我想在最后问一下，你是否觉得特朗普其实在倾听，也许

sentences.en: to the concerns that are being raised by voters and by people like Marjorie Taylor Greene.
sentences.zh: 正在倾听选民以及像玛乔丽·泰勒·格林这样的人所提出的担忧？

sentences.en: He's just kicked off this new domestic tour, the purpose of which is to go around the country and talk about issues of affordability.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚启动了这场全新的国内巡回演讲，其目的就是走遍全国，讨论生活成本高昂的问题。

sentences.en: — You're getting lower prices, bigger paychecks.
sentences.zh: ——你们正在获得更低的物价、更丰厚的薪水。

sentences.en: — And that does feel like an acknowledgment in some sense, that he knows he has a problem here.
sentences.zh: ——在某种程度上，这确实让人感觉他是在变相承认自己在这里遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: — Yes, that's true.
sentences.zh: ——是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: He certainly absorbed this.
sentences.zh: 他显然将这些听了进去。

sentences.en: I think that his testiness has been on full display.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的易怒情绪已经展露无遗。

sentences.en: — They said, he shouldn't be traveling.
sentences.zh: ——他们说，他不应该四处奔走。

sentences.en: He should focus on home.
sentences.zh: 他应该专注于国内。

sentences.en: What the hell do you think I'm doing?
sentences.zh: 你以为我到底在干什么？

sentences.en: — The posture is not one of voters, I hear you, I feel your pain.
sentences.zh: — 这个姿态可不像选民，我听到你们的心声了，我感同身受。

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 远非如此。

sentences.en: Instead, he has been dismissive of the word affordability.
sentences.zh: 相反，他对“负担能力”这个词一直不屑一顾。

sentences.en: — But they use the word affordability, and that's their only word.
sentences.zh: — 但他们确实用了“负担能力”这个词，而且这成了他们唯一的词。

sentences.en: They say affordability.
sentences.zh: 他们满口都是负担能力。

sentences.en: — But I think most of all, Natalie,
sentences.zh: — 但娜塔莉，我认为最重要的是，

sentences.en: what has annoyed Trump is that his voters had been generally trusting of everything that Trump said he was doing or was about to do during his first 100 days.
sentences.zh: 最让特朗普恼火的是，他的选民过去对特朗普在头一百天里所做或即将要做的一切通常都是深信不疑的。

sentences.en: — But the anxieties that his constituents are feeling is now impossible to hide, and I think that that has created a real defensiveness with Trump.
sentences.zh: — 但他的支持者们现在感到的焦虑已经无法掩饰，我认为这让特朗普产生了真正的防备心理。

sentences.en: — You know, the stupid people, they say, he should be living our country.
sentences.zh: — 那些蠢货说，他应该离开我们国家。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's sit around and twiddle our thumbs.
sentences.zh: 行吧，那我们就坐着无所事事好了。

sentences.en: — So will this tour that Trump is embarking on help mend the schisms in the Republican Party and restore him as the one and only voice in the conservative movement?
sentences.zh: — 那么，特朗普即将展开的这次巡回访问，能否有助于修复共和党内的分裂，并恢复他作为保守派运动唯一声音的地位？

sentences.en: Possibly.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: — But I do think that what we've seen take place is an emergence of voices who dare to hold the president accountable to his America First pledge.
sentences.zh: — 但我确实认为，我们所看到的是，一些敢于要求总统兑现其“美国优先”承诺的声音正在涌现。

sentences.en: — And as various people joust over just what that pledge should be, the fractures that ensue are really going to be impossible to heal.
sentences.zh: — 随着各方对这一承诺到底该是什么争论不休，随之而来的裂痕将真的无法弥合。

sentences.en: — It's hard to imagine what would happen to bring all those pieces back together.
sentences.zh: — 很难想象会发生什么才能把所有这些碎片重新拼凑起来。

sentences.en: — Well, Robert, thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: — 好的，罗伯特，非常感谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: — Sure thing, Natalie.
sentences.zh: — 不客气，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: — 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: — It's been an interesting day from the standpoint of news.
sentences.zh: — 从新闻的角度来看，这是有趣的一天。

sentences.en: — President Trump announced Wednesday afternoon that the U.S.
sentences.zh: — 特朗普总统周三下午宣布，美国

sentences.en: had seized an oil tanker off the coast of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉海岸附近扣押了一艘油轮。

sentences.en: — Large tanker, very large.
sentences.zh: — 一艘大油轮，非常大。

sentences.en: Largest one ever seized, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是有史以来扣押的最大的一艘。

sentences.en: — The seizure was a clear escalation in the administration's pressure campaign against Nicolas Maduro, the president of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: — 这一次扣押行动明显升级了政府对委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗施压的行动。

sentences.en: Trump didn't offer any additional details about the operation, but U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普没有提供有关这次行动的任何更多细节，但美国

sentences.en: officials, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, said the action was the result of deliberate planning and that there were no casualties.
sentences.zh: 官员在匿名的情况下表示，此举是精心策划的结果，行动中没有人员伤亡。

sentences.en: And the Federal Reserve voted on Wednesday to lower interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point.
sentences.zh: 美联储周三投票决定将利率下调四分之一个百分点。

sentences.en: It was the fourth straight boat in a row that wasn't backed by all members, a mark of just how fractured the central bank has become
sentences.zh: 这是连续第四次未能获得全体成员一致支持的决议，这标志着这家中央银行的分裂程度有多深，

sentences.en: as it struggles to balance the risks of rising unemployment and sticky inflation.
sentences.zh: 因为它正艰难地平衡失业率上升和顽固通胀的风险。
